_note: v1 ships ONE civilisation shared by every player (PLAN.md 1); players are told
apart by colour alone. That is a scope decision, not a change of architecture:
more civs return at 9.5 as a re-skin plus a rename over this identical roster
(PLAN.md 2.7.1), so this file is the seam holding their place. An absent file
and an empty one are different states and only one of them is a bug -- same
The single entry is `faction.default`, not `faction.neutral`: its job is to be
the default SKIN KEY that SimPlayer.faction holds and visuals.json falls back
to, and calling it neutral invites reading it as gaia or as a third player.
